title: Read a feature off the graph, or match an equation to its graph
subtitle: Linear functions · 12 official questions

sections.heading: Where this sits for you
body: **12 of the official questions in Linear functions are this one** — 7 Easy, 3 Medium, 2 Hard.
It is bottom-heavy, which makes it cheap points. Secure it early.

sections.heading: How to spot it
body: You are looking at this pattern when:
- There is a graph with no real-world story and you're asked for an intercept.
- Or you're given an equation and all four answer choices are graphs.

sections.heading: The method
body: - 1) For an intercept, find where the line crosses the named axis: the y-intercept is where x = 0.
- 2) To match a graph, use the y-intercept to rule out choices, then check the sign and steepness of the slope, stepping 1 right and m up.

sections.heading: Where Desmos fits
body: Graph the given equation and compare it with the pictured choices, or click the axis crossings to read the intercepts exactly.

sections.heading: What it is built to catch
body: You give the x-intercept when the question asked for the y-intercept, or write the point with its coordinates reversed.
When matching, you pick a graph with the right intercept but the wrong slope sign.

sections.heading: You are losing these
body: Before you choose, say out loud what the question is asking for — not what you solved for.
You give the x-intercept when the question asked for the y-intercept, or write the point with its coordinates reversed.
